guide.infinity_gauntlet.title: Infinity Gauntlet: Field Guide
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p1.5: Six stones, one gauntlet, and the power to unmake worlds.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p3.2: The gauntlet works only in your
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p3.6:
with it in hand.

Right-click it in your main hand to open the stone slots.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p4.3: Power, Space, Reality, Mind, Time, Soul.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p4.4: Stones can't be crafted yet: take them from the Infinity Gauntlet creative tab or use
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p5.4:
: the wheel opens. Point at a stone, then at an ability, and release V to choose.

Press
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p6.2: Hold R for charged powers: strike, beam, Reality.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p6.6:
switch stones.
A dimmed ability is unavailable: hover it to see why.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p7.4: : hold R to charge (purple aura), release to smash for damage and knockback.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p7.6: : full charge, then strike the ground.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p8.2: The planet shatters into fragments. You and nearby players are thrown into Dead Space.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p9.4:
: aim at the sun or moon and hold R for ~3 s. It cracks and falls, the sky turns red, and a 5-minute meteor shower begins.

No sun means eternal night.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p10.2:
Lock on the sun or moon, then aim at a patch of ground and release.

For 60 s meteors rain on that circle. You are safe from it.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p11.4: : opens a portal ahead for 30 s. Pick Nether, End or Overworld in the submenu.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p11.6: : teleport where you look, up to 96 blocks.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p12.2: Fly freely: WASD, Space up, Shift down,
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p12.4:
boosts.

Above Y=256 the sky darkens; around Y=640 you leave the atmosphere.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p13.2: A real Solar System: the Sun, eight planets and the Moon. Aim at a body to see its name and distance.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p13.4: : pick it in the wheel, press R. 2.5 s charge, then you land on the lit side.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p14.4:
, or just fly down to its surface.

Other worlds are solid: you can't land on them.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p15.4:
: tap R. A red wave turns nearby mobs into butterflies (no drops) and the ground into redstone and fire.

This change is real.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p16.2:
Hold R: the world cracks, folds and turns inside out around your gaze. Turn your head to steer the rift.

It only changes your view. Release and everything returns. You can't walk while holding.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p17.4: : you are played back along your last 5 seconds, health and hunger included.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p17.6: : spins the sky to the other half of the day (Overworld only, 30 s cooldown).
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p18.4:
: on terrain it rips out a chunk of real blocks; on a mob it lifts the mob (not bosses). Move your gaze to steer.

Press R again to
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p19.2: A thrown cluster hits everything around and crumbles into falling blocks.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p19.4: : a held mob shakes, turns red and bursts. Loot and XP drop.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p20.4:
: aim at a mob. Its soul is pulled out and absorbed.

Each soul gives
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p20.8: damage for 60 s, up to 20 stacks.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p21.2:
A wave pulls the souls of every enemy within 24 blocks. Cooldown 45 s.

Bosses, peaceful mobs and named mobs are safe. On players it drains up to 2 hearts.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p22.4:
. Hold R: 2 s charge, then a 6 s beam of 72 blocks.

It drills a 9-block tunnel (bedrock stays) and takes 70% of the Ender Dragon's health. Cooldown 45 s.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p23.2:
Also needs all six stones. The universe is erased: everyone lands in the white void and the gauntlet burns out.

To undo it, right-click a loose
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p24.2: Uru is a rare metal in the Overworld, from the bedrock up to Y=0, richest near
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p24.4: . Rarer than diamonds; the ore glows faintly.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p25.4:
. Fortune works; Silk Touch keeps the ore.

Smelt the ore or
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p25.6: in a furnace or blast furnace into
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p26.2:
Craft it like iron armor, from Uru ingots: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots.

Fireproof, tougher than netherite (24 armor points). Repair with ingots on an anvil.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p27.2:
A full six-stone gauntlet ignores normal armor and shields. A complete Uru set lets through only 25% of such a hit; instant kills become survivable.

World events are not blocked.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p28.2:
Takes a stone from someone's gauntlet. Hold right-click on a target within 16 blocks and in sight.

Three 3-second cycles pull the stone out. Progress is kept for 20 s.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p29.2:
Shift + right-click on nothing picks which stone to pull. A stone in use can't be taken.

Shift + right-click with a stone inside takes it out; right-click on nothing returns it to your gauntlet.
guide.infinity_gauntlet.p30.6:
(bottom left). Auto, English or Русский.

All keys can be rebound in Controls.
